environment.description: Celery worker deployed on EC2 instances in a public subnet with an internet-facing ALB forwarding task results. The Celery result backend (Redis) is accessible from the gateway service which exposes processing_time_ns in HTTP response headers (X-Processing-Time). Attacker can submit repeated validation requests and observe timing differences in the response to perform a character-by-character hash oracle attack.

config.network: Public subnet with IGW, ALB with public DNS
